look_here_first: Treat this as the tall biennial evening-primrose comparison: a first-year basal rosette followed by an erect flowering stem with yellow 4-petaled evening-opening flowers and elongate capsules.

lookalikes.differences: Much taller and more erect than low O. laciniata or spreading O. capillifolia; identification and local-range certification are separate questions.
